review_scope: Local original frozen crop images and downloaded predictions only; not model inputs; not independent held-out validation. Correct means no observed mathematical content/grouping omission within the frozen formula region. Named-function font commands and math whitespace treated as presentation; bold vector identity is preserved as a requirement.
full_expression_rule: Complete formula-only content and source-sensitive notation; generic common align* display wrapper allowed for every unchanged body. Incomplete native-stop output is null, not mathematical false. Exact glyph-star identity remains ambiguous and is not promoted by script attachment.
component_policy: Enumerated core relations; ordinary scripts exclude sum limits, which have a separate denominator. Formula-core correctness never promotes surrounding prose or incomplete output to full correctness.
